node.statement: Missing-premise audit: the root quantifies over an arbitrary def-four-corner-merging-datum and gives only rho <= C_cross^0*t and epsilon_{A_R} <= t <= W.e_cross. The registered def-four-corner-merging-datum contains projections, four fixed maps, amplified defect inequalities, and quantitative complementarity, but does not assert that B_U oplus B_V is a finite-dimensional C*-algebra or that A_R is a finite-dimensional extended epsilon_{A_R}-C*-algebra. Node 1.3 supplies only an asserted extended isomorphism and likewise cannot establish those types. Hence the conditional bridge above cannot be discharged from the current root; adding the two type hypotheses is necessary before unit control may be applied.
